name: Arcane 1
description: Ancien Endormi réveillé libérant la puissance oubliée des ères pré-cosmiques remodelant temporairement les règles physiques du champ de bataille.

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes altérées par l'exposition aux énergies chthoniennes. Peaux pâles translucides avec runes sombres. Yeux entièrement noirs. Ombres détachées., one-of-a-kind materials
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's heal ability (self) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Transcendent manifestation — character as the ultimate embodiment of their entire faction's philosophy and power — Golden regenerative energy wrapping around wounds, restoring damaged flesh and armor
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — cosmic significance visible in every feature

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Celestial multi-layered lighting: divine light from above, energy emanation from below, inner glow from character's own power, environmental reflections on a cosmic scale

scenography.setting: Ancient underground temple with impossible non-Euclidean geometry, walls covered in carved forbidden symbols, massive sealed portal doors radiating dark energy
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Eerie pulsating purple fog along the ground, shadow tendrils detaching and reattaching, pulsating ancient runes glowing intermittently, warped light bending unnaturally, plus self-repair — visible mending of injuries closing before the viewer's eyes visible in the environment
